facts.value: The Corvina site calls the library the first royal library outside Italy and north of the Alps.
facts.quote: the first royal library outside Italy and north of the Alps
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://corvina.hu/en/about-corvinas/history/history-of-the-library/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'the first royal library outside Italy and north of the Alps'

facts.value: The Corvina site says the collection was destroyed most probably after Mohacs in 1526. Surviving volumes went to Istanbul as loot.
facts.quote: The collection was destroyed during the Ottoman invasion, most probably, after the Battle of Mohács (1526). Surviving volumes were taken to Istanbul as part of the loot
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://corvina.hu/en/about-corvinas/history/history-of-the-library/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'Surviving volumes were taken to Istanbul as part of the loot'

facts.value: Hungarian kings showed guests round the library hall and gave some volumes away as presents.
facts.quote: gave away some volumes as presents
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://corvina.hu/en/about-corvinas/history/history-of-the-library/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'gave away some volumes as presents'

facts.value: The royal librarian Taddeo Ugoleto went to Florence in 1488 to organise a deliberate extension of the Hungarian royal library with volumes from Italy.
facts.quote: Taddeo Ugoleto from Parma travelled to Florence in 1488 to organize the conscious extension of the Hungarian royal library
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://corvina.hu/en/about-corvinas/history/history-of-the-library/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'travelled to Florence in 1488 to organize'

facts.value: A detail from a Trapezuntius corvina appears on the Hungarian 1,000 forint banknote.
facts.quote: Trapezuntius corvina (OSZK Cod. Lat. 281 f2r) on the Hungarian money
